result.task: Migrate the alignment, storage, mapping, timeline and renderer from the old five-state mouth vocabulary to the frozen eleven-pose vocabulary, including a versioned storage migration for existing avatars.
result.summary:
Implemented the eleven-pose migration across the requested modules.

- Alignment/baking now supports partial pose captures and only emits captured frames.
- Mapper uses the frozen pose tables and constants.
- Timeline protects `CLOSED`, `TEETH_LIP`, and `TH` spans.
- Renderer resolves against available avatar frames, preserves opaque-heavy compositing, and exposes available poses in snapshots. Tongue remains included in articulation snapshots.
- Storage writes schema v2 JPEG frames at quality `0.92`, migrates v1 `OPEN` to `BIG_OPEN` in memory, and provides `getPoseAvailability()`.
- Tests were updated for the new vocabulary, protected poses, availability-aware resolution, and legacy migration.
- Frozen contract files and UI files were not changed.

Files changed: [bake.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/align/bake.ts), [region.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/align/region.ts), [visemeMapper.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/core/visemeMapper.ts), [timeline.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/core/timeline.ts), [lipSyncPlayer.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/player/lipSyncPlayer.ts), [avatarStore.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/store/avatarStore.ts), and the two requested test files.
